# TAP Migration Assistant

This repository is focused on evaluating and planning the migration of test automation projects to the TAP (Test Automation Platform).

## What is TAP

TAP is an internal test automation platform that supports:
- API automation testing
- Web UI automation testing (browser-based)
- App UI automation testing (mobile/desktop)
- Performance testing (load, stress, benchmarks)
- Test data management (creation, seeding, cleanup)
- Azure DevOps pipeline integration
- Execution on designated agent machines

> TAP capability boundaries should be confirmed with the TAP development team. When a capability is uncertain, always mark it as "Unknown" and flag it for team confirmation rather than assuming support.

## Your Role

When asked to assess a project's TAP migration feasibility, always follow the structured assessment methodology defined in `.github/instructions/tap-migration-assessment.instructions.md`.

Do not skip phases or jump to recommendations without completing the evidence-gathering steps first.
